# Cully 0.22.0

- **Cully scores itself, and you approve the fixes.** The advisor daemon runs `cully eval` every five hours (`CULLY_EVAL_INTERVAL` changes it, `off` disables it), keeps the history, and turns failing checks into suggestions. `cully improve` opens a window: select a suggestion, read the failing checks behind it, then Apply (the plan is shown first and written only when you confirm) or Drop (confirmed, and the only way a suggestion is dropped). Changes are limited to rules and one skill under `~/.cully`; suggestions never add MCP servers or run commands, and hooks are not written automatically. Separate from the project advisor and `cully apply`.
- **Evals that match what Cully is for.** New `improve` and `tasks` suites score the self-improvement loop and task efficiency (verified or not, time, steps, orientation before the first edit, rework, loops) against hand-worked sessions, and `cully eval --repeat N` fails when a deterministic suite gives different results. Cully records when you apply a change, and `tasks` compares median time and steps before and after it in the same project, with no verdict on a thin sample.
- **More honest numbers.** Some Claude transcripts repeat tool entries, which inflated the waste, whole-file read, Bash and delegation estimates and `cully savings` cost by up to about twice. Each tool call is now counted once; on one project the oversized-output estimate fell from 149,504 to 127,151 tokens and Cully's measured injected cost from 82,640 to 63,087. `cully impact --explain` itemizes how the net figure is built and shows what Cully's own calls injected, which the net does not subtract.
- **Scroll back through the agent's output.** The mouse wheel now reads the last 10,000 lines of the agent's output in the Cully terminal, the panel shows how far back you are, and typing returns to the live screen. An agent on the alternate screen still receives the wheel.
- **A truer panel.** The Git row counts new files and their lines, so `+N` reflects uncommitted work; the MCP row shows the connection and authentication state from `claude mcp list` when tool responses have not established it; the 5h and weekly limits and the Harness, Project & usage and Cully impact columns are colored.
- **Safer rendering.** Escape sequences and control characters in model-written plans and evaluation details are stripped before they are printed or written.

Update with `cully update --version v0.22.0`, or use the [installer](https://docs.cully.net/installation). Rerun `cully setup` with your original options to refresh installed hooks and skills.

Suggestions from the improvement loop need the `claude` CLI to plan a change today. The scheduled run has not been observed over a long-lived daemon, and the before and after comparison is uncontrolled because the work differs between sessions. Token figures are estimates, not billing. See the [self-improvement guide](https://docs.cully.net/self-improvement) and [evaluation guide](https://docs.cully.net/evals).
